3y.start_rule: first trading day on/after start date; last trading day on/before end date (each market)

calendar.metrics: union of US (NYSE/Nasdaq) and ASX trading days, values forward-filled

2y.start_rule: first trading day on/after start date; last trading day on/before end date (each market)

calendar.metrics: union of US (NYSE/Nasdaq) and ASX trading days, values forward-filled

split_check.note: Yahoo 'Close' is already split-adjusted (no 10x jump), so split is handled in both Close and Adj Close.

method.prices: Yahoo Finance via yfinance history(auto_adjust=False): 'Adj Close' (adjusted for splits and cash dividends/distributions, back-adjusted multiplicatively) used as the total-return price.
method.fx: USD stocks: A$ = USD adj close / AUDUSD=X close (US$ per A$1). SK hynix: A$ = KRW adj close / AUDKRW=X close (KRW per A$1), cross-checked against KRW=X x AUDUSD=X. FX taken on the same calendar date as the stock close (last FX close on/before if missing).
method.calendar: Daily A$ values on the union of US and ASX trading days, each asset's last known close (and FX) forward-filled. SK hynix (KRX) is forward-filled onto that calendar.
method.timezone: KRX (15:30 KST) and ASX (16:00 AEST/AEDT) close many hours before the US close (16:00 ET = next morning in Australia). Same-date closes are not simultaneous, so daily A-vs-B correlation and beta are understated; weekly figures and a one-day-lag correlation are shown as a check. Yahoo FX 'close' is a London-evening snapshot, not exactly at any market's close.
method.vol: stdev of daily simple returns (sample, ddof=1) x sqrt(252), on the metrics calendar
method.sharpe: (CAGR - rf) / vol, rf = time-weighted average RBA cash rate target over the period
method.sortino: (CAGR - rf) / downside deviation; downside deviation = sqrt(mean(min(r_d - rf/252, 0)^2)) x sqrt(252) over all days
method.max_dd: min over t of V_t / max_{s<=t} V_s - 1 on daily values
method.rolling_12m: V_t / V_(last day on/before t-365 days) - 1 for every t at least 365 days after the start
method.calendar_year: value at last day on/before 31 Dec of year / value at last day on/before 31 Dec of prior year - 1 (only years fully inside the period)
method.beta: cov(r_A, r_B) / var(r_B), daily and weekly (Friday) simple returns
method.portfolio_A: A$5,000 in each stock at its first close on/after the start date (with that day's FX), no rebalancing, dividends reinvested via adjusted prices
method.portfolio_B: A$20,000 in SEMI.AX at its first close on/after the start date, distributions reinvested via adjusted prices
method.costs: No brokerage, FX spreads, taxes or withholding tax on dividends.
